scope: Personal deploy integration; all database tests used disposable localhost PostgreSQL, no production changes

results.name: legacy publication and document bytes remain intact without schema changes
personal information and presentation, including job interests, persist on reload
empty profile, zero CV count, authenticated six-axis radar
manual save triggers NLP and publishes without scoring pending skills
administrative approval is persisted, scored and idempotent
a pending CV does not remove an already approved manual contribution
experience change updates approved relevance and leaves detections pending
editing and deleting sources removes stale approved contributions automatically
education and certification changes participate in the same pipeline
certification fields and attachment save atomically and metadata survives a new login
a late old analysis cannot overwrite the latest publication
publication failure preserves saved profile and last snapshot; retry recovers
textual CV extraction uses the owner and never approves detections automatically
unreadable current CV never falls back to an older textual CV
duplicate manual ids are rejected without changing the stored selection
a fresh login recovers the persisted profile, skills and radar
matching route validates input and wraps results without global pipes or interceptors
recruiter companies come from authenticated bindings and exclude foreign companies
company vacancy creation and private listings require the actual owner binding
recruitment uses the current approved radar and an approved owner CV
applications require explicit radar consent and remain owned and idempotent
recruiter radar and area evidence use real applications and reject foreign company access
contact and CV permissions are independent and revocation takes effect immediately
revoking radar visibility also removes evidence and CV access until restored
hiring rejection and withdrawal persist and cannot be overwritten or reactivated

scenarios: login real y habilidad manual guardada desde la UI
guardar experiencia actualiza habilidades detectadas sin recargar la página
aprobación real, radar publicado y detalle de evidencia del propietario
móvil sin desbordamiento horizontal y eliminación retira el aporte aprobado del radar
cerrar sesión y entrar con otro usuario no reutiliza el perfil anterior
alta de certificación con campos y PDF desde una sola operación de UI
archivo inválido conserva los campos y el respaldo guardados previamente
nuevo login recupera nombre, fecha y respaldo; editar campos conserva el archivo
radar a 320 px sin desbordamiento y menú móvil accesible
empresa autenticada publica desde los tres pasos con su vínculo real y persiste la vacante
titulado ve la vacante real y postula desde UI con consentimientos independientes
la empresa ve al postulante y su radar publicado en matching
una cuenta sin empresa muestra el estado correcto y no hereda la empresa de otra sesión
login administrativo llega a revisión y los permisos de empresa se aplican en la UI

production: Not published or connected; no backend .env present in local deploy repo; Vercel environment variables not inspected
